gradients.forbidden: No decorative gradients. Gradient use allowed only for 'Active State' borders or data visualization fills.

surfaces.card_style: Sharp corners (rounded-sm) or Chamfered edges. 1px solid border. Minimal shadow.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers. High blur (backdrop-blur-md), low opacity.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-sm hover:bg-orange-600 shadow-sm font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95

inputs.style: rounded-sm border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2
inputs.focus_state: Ring color should match Primary (Orange) or Info (Blue) depending on context.

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-sm border shadow-sm p-4 h-full flex flex-col justify-between

form_builder.canvas: bg-dot-pattern border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-md min-h-[600px] relative
form_builder.draggable_item: cursor-move bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-2 rounded-sm hover:border-primary hover:shadow-md transition-all

charts.style: Minimal axes. Tooltip uses 'Card' style. Colors map to Semantic palette.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay on dark mode backgrounds to prevent banding.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (Stroke width 1.5px for elegance, 2px for active states).

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-precision audit tool. Prioritize data density and legibility over decorative whitespace. Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for all dashboards.
instructions_to_main_agent.form_builder: Implement the Drag-and-Drop builder using 'dnd-kit' or 'react-beautiful-dnd'. The canvas must look like a physical paper sheet (A4 aspect ratio) on a desk background.
instructions_to_main_agent.theming: Ensure dark mode is not just 'black', but 'rich charcoal' (#09090B) to reduce eye strain. Text contrast must be WCAG AA compliant.
instructions_to_main_agent.code_style: Use functional components. Keep logic in custom hooks. Use Shadcn UI for base primitives but style them according to the 'Industrial Architect' persona.

universal_guidelines.frontend_philosophy: Anti-AI Slop. Avoid generic rounded corners (xl/2xl). Go sharp (sm/md). Avoid purple/teal gradients. Use orange/monochrome.
universal_guidelines.interaction: Buttons should feel 'tactile'. Active states should scale down slightly (scale-95).
universal_guidelines.charts: Use 'recharts'. Don't use 3D charts. Flat, clean lines or bars.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Focus rings must be visible. Use 'ring-offset-2' and 'ring-2'.
universal_guidelines.file_structure: Components in /components/ui are shared. Feature-specific components in /features/[feature_name]/components.
